m.t: Una de ésas sillas con forma de una mano gigante.
m.e: One of those chairs shaped like a giant hand.

m.t: ¿Ésas son las cosas que empiezas a decir una vez que cortan tu verga?
m.e: That the sort of thing you start to say once your dick gets chopped off?

m.t: Crowe solo pudo gritar, cuando una de ésas la despedazó por dentro.
m.e: All Crowe could do was scream, when one tore her insides apart.

m.t: Ésas no son sus sillas.
m.e: Those are not your chairs.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #587348 by Shishir; English translation #41952 by adjusting

m.t: Ésas son personas muy famosas.
m.e: Those are very famous people.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5854086 by arh; English translation #2235277 by CK

m.t: Ésas son buenas noticias.
m.e: That's good news.

m.t: Ésas son las preguntas.
m.e: Those are the questions.

m.t: ¿Ésas son mis gafas?
m.e: Are those my glasses?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8296656 by GuidoW; English translation #2647233 by CK

m.t: ¡Ajá! Con que ¿ésas tenemos?
m.e: Aha! So that's what's going on!
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2258101 by carlosalberto; English translation #2258100 by _undertoad

m.t: Hoy es el primero y último día de la semana para mí.
m.e: Today is the first and the last day of the week for me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2298701 by needaworker; English translation #11348786 by qwertzu

m.t: Mira, me alegra que ella sea lo primero en tu vida ahora.
m.e: Look, I'm glad she comes first in your life now.

m.t: Así que tenemos que matarlo primero antes de que le diga a alguien.
m.e: So we've got to kill him first before he tells anyone.

m.t: Lo primero que hizo fue limpiar las armas.
m.e: The first thing he did was clean the weapons.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5939582 by arh; English translation #12982241 by rul

m.t: Bueno, si lo fuera, serías el primero en saberlo, ¿no?
m.e: Well, if he was, you'd be the first to know it, wouldn't you?

m.t: La foto es lo primero que se nota.
m.e: The photo is the first thing you notice.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5169036 by Silvestre; English translation #5177229 by tabular

m.t: Ella me dijo que llegó allí primero.
m.e: She told me that she got there first.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8084982 by Ricardo14; English translation #7392458 by CH

m.t: Lo siento, debería haber llamado primero.
m.e: Sorry, I should've called first.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10785086 by megamanenm; English translation #10785083 by megamanenm

m.t: Él fue el primero en ayudarla.
m.e: He was the first to help her.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #359744 by tatoerique; English translation #453448 by FeuDRenais

m.t: Lo primero que hice en esta realidad fue adquirir mi magia.
m.e: The very first thing I did in this reality was acquire my magic.

m.t: ¿Cómo te fue estos primeros días de escuela?
m.e: How were your first days at school?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1230911 by hayastan; English translation #5226788 by jaxhere

m.t: Ellos fueron los primeros en subir al autobús.
m.e: They were the first to get into the bus.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #963066 by hundo; English translation #305985 by \N

m.t: No estaba en casa cuando el bebé dio sus primeros pasos.
m.e: I wasn't at home when the baby took its first steps.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9114685 by carlosalberto; English translation #4338572 by Lepotdeterre

m.t: Yo estaba bajo mucha presión para escribir los primeros ocho canciones.
m.e: I was just under a lot of pressure to write the first eight songs.

m.t: Durante los primeros días de agosto, hace calor.
m.e: During the first days of August, it is hot.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #11164893 by carlosalberto; English translation #11164865 by carlosalberto

m.t: Los primeros 40 años de la infancia son los más difíciles.
m.e: The first 40 years of childhood are the most difficult.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3888268 by ManuelML; English translation #3890619 by Delian

m.t: ¿Por qué no recordamos los primeros años de vida?
m.e: Why don't we remember the first years of our lives?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7490790 by Ricardo14; English translation #7490791 by Ricardo14

m.t: Siempre es bueno tener una caja de primeros auxilios en el auto.
m.e: It's always good to have a first aid kit in the car.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #976589 by hayastan; English translation #10179103 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Los primeros años no podía soportar que me tocaran.
m.e: The first few years, I couldn't bear to be touched.

m.t: No son los primeros niños a ir.
m.e: They're not the first kids to go.

m.t: Se me ocurrió traer algunas de mis primeras películas.
m.e: So, I thought, I'll bring along some of my first movies.

m.t: Sí, pero estas son las primeras víctimas que de hecho tenían dinero.
m.e: Yeah, but these are the first victims that actually had money.

m.t: Quinto: acabo de olvidar cuáles eran las cuatro primeras cosas.
m.e: Fifthly, I just forgot what the first four things were.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1457929 by Shishir; English translation #873908 by papabear

m.t: Esas son las primeras que empecé por rescatar.
m.e: Those are the ones I started to rescue.

m.t: Mi abuela fue una de las primeras detectives privadas de España.
m.e: My grandma was one of the first private detectives in Spain.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7905381 by Seael; English translation #13946751 by araneo

m.t: Estoy tomando mis primeras lecciones de vuelo en la actualidad.
m.e: I'm taking my first flying lessons today.

m.t: Eres muy diligente en las primeras horas de la mañana.
m.e: You're really diligent in the early hours of the morning.

m.t: Su casa fue una de nuestras primeras redadas, de pies a cabeza.
m.e: His house was one of our first raids, Bill, top to bottom.

m.t: Su biblioteca tiene 3.500 libros e incluye muchas primeras ediciones.
m.e: Her library has 3,500 books and includes many first editions.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1237338 by Shishir; English translation #903433 by CK

m.t: Ella tiene 3500 libros en su biblioteca y muchos de ellos son primeras ediciones.
m.e: She has 3,500 books in her library and many of them are first editions.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1696181 by teskmon; English translation #903427 by CK

m.t: Los pueblos de las Primeras Naciones tienen historias interesantes que contar.
m.e: The First Nations peoples have interesting stories to tell.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10776978 by nonong; English translation #10776977 by nonong

m.t: De primeras, es demasiado caro.
m.e: First, it's too expensive.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1245594 by wallebot; English translation #1245111 by Eldad

m.t: Te necesito aquí por si vuelve a pasar algo.
m.e: I need you here in case something else happens.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5706574 by arh; English translation #5704955 by CK

m.t: ¿Crees que todo vuelve a estar bien entre nosotros?
m.e: Well, do you think everything is OK again between us?

m.t: Te esperaré aquí. Vuelve mañana por la noche.
m.e: I will wait here for you. Come back tomorrow evening.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1198522 by cueyayotl; English translation #1196195 by FiRez

m.t: Vuelve dentro de un mes.
m.e: Come back within a month.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6079656 by JRB; English translation #73238 by CK

m.t: ¡Vuelve a casa y llama a la Policía!
m.e: Go back home and call the police!
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1701678 by marcelostockle; English translation #1700254 by charlotte13

m.t: Vuelve a su casa.
m.e: Go back to his house.

m.t: Sólo... Vuelve a la cama.
m.e: Just... you go back to bed.

m.t: En ese momento todavía no había vuelto a casa.
m.e: I hadn't returned home yet by that point.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10741998 by megamanenm; English translation #10741995 by megamanenm

m.t: Ha vuelto con su novia y su hijo, así lo que está eso.
m.e: He's back with his girl and his kid, so there's that.

m.t: Ellos aún no han vuelto a la casa.
m.e: They haven't come back home yet.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2492172 by marcelostockle; English translation #306035 by CK

m.t: Todavía no han vuelto a casa.
m.e: They haven't come back home yet.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4916729 by Shishir; English translation #306035 by CK

m.t: Sabes, deja que te vuelva a llamar en cinco minutos.
m.e: Eh, you know, let me call you back in five minutes.

m.t: Puedo ir, siempre que vuelva antes de las cinco.
m.e: I can go, as long as I'm back by five.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1431476 by Shishir; English translation #10179121 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Necesito su ayuda para que mi hijo vuelva a casa conmigo.
m.e: I need his help to get my son to come back home with me.

m.t: Puede que yo ya no vuelva aquí jamás.
m.e: I might never come back here again.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7933963 by Seael; English translation #5937281 by CK

m.t: Quiero que la vida vuelva a ser como era antes.
m.e: I want life to go back to the way it was before.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2102090 by Shishir; English translation #2032012 by CK

m.t: No me digas que vas a hacer que vuelva al trabajo.
m.e: Don't tell me you're gonna make me go back to work.

m.t: Porque yo sé que volveré a ver a mi esposa algún día.
m.e: Because I know that I am gonna see my wife again someday.

m.t: Te juro que jamás lo volveré a hacer.
m.e: I swear to you I will never do it again.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #966249 by gleOsp; English translation #1987841 by marcelostockle

m.t: Si alguien llega mientras no estoy, dile que no volveré hasta la tarde.
m.e: If anyone comes in my absence, tell him that I won't come back till evening.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2182782 by leoruilova; English translation #30570 by CK

m.t: Volveré a por ti, ¿vale?
m.e: I'm gonna come back for you, okay?

m.t: Y no volveré, ni puedo, al infierno.
m.e: And I will not, and cannot, go back to hell.

m.t: ¿Y por qué vuelvo a ello una vez tras otra?
m.e: And why do I return to it over and over?

m.t: Vuelvo aquí de vez en cuando.
m.e: I come back here every now and then.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12401177 by DJ_Saidez; English translation #12113090 by espamatics

m.e: I'll go eat lunch and then come back.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9008528 by arh; English translation #9176684 by DJ_Saidez

m.e: If I go back down there without 100, then your problem becomes my problem.

m.e: Looks like he came back to the bank the following day.

m.t: Después de aquello no volvió.
m.e: After that, he didn't come back.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9008521 by arh; English translation #9188949 by DJ_Saidez

m.e: William retraced his steps, but you were gone.

m.t: Ahora él está en el trabajo, pero volverá a las siete.
m.e: He is at work now, but will return at seven.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #356712 by tatoerique; English translation #296505 by \N

m.t: Mi padre volverá a casa este fin de semana.
m.e: My dad will come back home this weekend.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1097098 by Shishir; English translation #13041896 by araneo

m.e: What time do you think he'll come back?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1286375 by alexmarcelo; English translation #1284862 by CH

m.e: "We should never come here again" "because it would never be as much fun."

m.t: Más te vale que no vuelvas a hacer eso.
m.e: You'd better not do that again.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10117924 by DJ_Saidez; English translation #2694069 by Hybrid

m.e: I'm letting you leave, provided that you do not come back late.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1102548 by alexmarcelo; English translation #8667965 by nvt123

m.e: And then I went back in for a couple of years.

m.t: Sí, lo fui. 30 años y después volví como civil.
m.e: I was, yeah. 30 years and then I come back as a civvy.

m.t: Solo prométeme que volveremos en cuanto la tengamos.
m.e: Just promise me we'll come back here when we have her.

m.t: No volveremos a Boston.
m.e: We won't go back to Boston.

m.e: We may never get another chance like this again.

m.t: Tú te debes quedar aquí hasta que nosotros volvamos.
m.e: You are to stay here until we come back.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1182554 by marcelostockle; English translation #16094 by Swift

m.t: Quizás volvamos de todos modos sólo para recordar.
m.e: Maybe we go back anyway just to remember.

m.t: ¿Quieres que volvamos a saltar en el tiempo juntos?
m.e: You want us to time jump together again?

m.t: ¿Por qué no te vuelves a poner la ropa?
m.e: Why don't you put your clothes back on?

m.e: Maybe you'll come back soon, now that I have more time for you.

m.e: Why don't you go back inside and do your job?

m.t: Bueno, ¿por qué no te limpias y te vuelves a dormir?
m.e: Well, uh, why don't you clean yourself up and go back to sleep, huh?

m.t: Puede que algunos vuelvan a estar al otro lado.
m.e: Some of them may be again on the other side of it.

m.t: Bien, esta es nuestra última canción, así que vuelvan.
m.e: Okay. So this is our last song, so come back in.

m.t: Vuelvan a sus asientos.
m.e: Go back to your seats.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #434789 by lukaszpp; English translation #434788 by lukaszpp

m.t: Me lo llevaré conmigo y no volverás a verme.
m.e: I'll take him with me, and you'll never see me again.

m.t: Volverás mejor que nunca, no te preocupes.
m.e: You're gonna come back better than ever. Don't worry about it.

m.e: And you, when will you go back to where you began?

m.e: When do you go back to Germany?

m.e: So, uh, what do you say we get back to it, huh?

m.e: If we lose him, come back the next day, pick him up right where were we lost him.

m.t: ¿Por qué no volvemos al hotel?
m.e: Why don't we go back to the hotel?

m.e: Can we just stop trying to protect each other and go back to being friends?

m.t: Traté de tirar mis zapatos, pero siempre vuelven.
m.e: I tried to throw my shoes away, but they keep coming back.

m.e: Question is, if they come back, is it the same storm, or has something changed?

m.e: He said he'd be back later on this afternoon.

m.t: No es mi nombre, solo como quien volvería.
m.e: It's not my name; It's just what I would come back as.

m.t: Entonces yo... volvería en el tiempo antes de que esto pasara.
m.e: Then I... I'd go back in time before any of this happened.

m.t: Lo hice, y lo volvería a hacer.
m.e: I did it, and I'd do it again!

m.t: ¿Qué pasó, te volviste a caer en la taza de té?
m.e: What happened, you fell into a tea cup again?

m.t: Si estás tan asustado, ¿entonces por qué volviste?
m.e: Now, if you so spooked, why you come back anyway?

m.t: ¿Por qué? ¿Volviste al gimnasio?
m.e: What, did you go back to the gym?

m.t: Ya han pasado cinco años desde que volvieron de Japón.
m.e: It's already been five years since they returned from Japan.

m.t: ¿Volvieron para acabar con nosotros?
m.e: Come back to finish us off?

m.e: Soon they'll return, singing songs of men in gold masks.

m.e: All these soldiers, but how many will come back home in one piece?

m.t: Volverán a como estaba todo hace dos días.
m.e: They'll go back to the way things were two days ago.

m.t: Error mío por... volverme hacia el sonido de tu voz.
m.e: Ha, my bad for... turning towards the sound of your voice.

m.t: Yo estaba en el cumpleaños de mi amigo y... volvía a casa.
m.e: I was at my friend's birthday party and... I was going back home.

m.t: Y ella se iba a hacer mandados o algo y volvía.
m.e: And she was just gonna go run some errands, and come back.

m.t: Solomon me dijo que o volvía o me haría daño.
m.e: Solomon told me I had to go back or he'll hurt me.

m.t: Cuando tenía tu edad, yo iba y volvía al colegio en bicicleta todos los días.
m.e: When I was your age, I bicycled to and from school every day.

m.e: She asked me to stay till her mother came home.

m.e: I didn't like him to come back home while I was sleeping.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #818735 by moyamoyatenshi; English translation #1324762 by marcelostockle

m.t: Solo quería que Mike volviera al lugar de donde vino.
m.e: I just wanted Mike to go back to where he came from.

m.t: Sami advirtió a Layla que no volviera a bajar por esa calle.
m.e: Sami warned Layla not to go back down that street.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12253055 by Fueyes; English translation #7183670 by OsoHombre

m.e: We went back to my office in the retreat house.

m.t: Los dos volvimos a caer en los malos hábitos.
m.e: We both kept falling back into bad habits.

m.e: Stop "effing" around and get back on the phones, now!

m.t: Por favor, volved y esposadme a esta silla.
m.e: Please come back here and cuff me to this chair.

m.t: Volved al salón y os llamaré cuando esté.
m.e: You guys go back into the living room, and I'll call you when it's ready.

m.t: Ponedlo en cualquier sitio donde haya hueco, y volved donde os encontré.
m.e: Just put them down wherever there's space, and then go back to where I found you.

m.t: Mi hermano me está esperando en la escuela.
m.e: My brother is waiting for me at the school.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #690053 by Shishir; English translation #689941 by ulyssemc1

m.e: While we're waiting, why don't you tell me what happened?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1535220 by marcelostockle; English translation #1532017 by LittleBoy

m.t: Ella me hizo esperar más de una hora.
m.e: She kept me waiting for over an hour.

m.t: ¡No puedo esperar por el fin de semana!
m.e: I can't wait until the weekend!
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1434311 by marcelostockle; English translation #1020773 by Brian255

m.t: Ese es un cambio que todos podemos esperar.
m.e: That's a change that we can all hope for.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10170450 by manufrutos; English translation #10167298 by CK

m.t: Mucho más de lo que podíamos esperar.
m.e: Much more than we could expect.

m.t: No puedes esperar más que eso.
m.e: You can't expect more than that.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1713330 by marcelostockle; English translation #41736 by CK

m.t: Que alguien venga a la cafetería y espere conmigo.
m.e: Someone please come to the cafeteria and wait with me.

m.t: Que un auto me espere abajo, y consígueme esa lista.
m.e: Have a car waiting downstairs for me. And get me that list.

m.t: Ella mató el tiempo leyendo una revista mientras esperaba.
m.e: She killed time reading a magazine while she waited.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #918359 by inmachan; English translation #315651 by CK

m.t: Esperaba que pudiera ayudarme con un caso.
m.e: I was hoping he could help me with a case.

m.t: De verdad esperaba que te pudieras mejor.
m.e: I really hoped you were getting better.

m.t: Yo esperaba que él se recuperaría.
m.e: I had hoped that he would recover.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1421663 by marcelostockle; English translation #283472 by CK

m.t: Esperaba que nos hiciéramos amigos.
m.e: I'd hoped we'd become friends.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10106254 by manufrutos; English translation #10098418 by CK

m.t: La película fue más interesante de lo que yo esperaba.

m.t: Este... este sitio no es lo que me esperaba.
m.e: This, um... this place isn't what I was expecting.

m.t: Eso era más difícil de lo que me esperaba.
m.e: That was more difficult than I expected.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8950400 by diegohn; English translation #6224131 by CK

m.e: Expect an 0700 arrival of our operations personnel.

m.e: Wait, no one told you?

m.t: No esperen demasiado de él.
m.e: Don't expect too much of him.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2086620 by marcelostockle; English translation #284541 by CK
